scope: PHP 8.1 support validation for every frozen Laravel series that includes PHP 8.1
browserContractCoverage: five frozen viewports across legacy layout profiles
regressionsFixedDuringValidation: consumer fixture could install Packagist dcat/laravel-admin instead of the current fork
consumer Bash scripts could mask failed PHP commands
modern consumer setup rolled back the installed admin database before browser login
Laravel 8/9 fresh locks required with-all-dependencies to resolve DBAL-compatible carbon-doctrine-types
inline Blade @php(...) syntax was not portable to the Laravel 10 Blade compiler
system feedback assumed flash values were MessageBag-like objects and failed on scalar login success messages
reduced-motion did not cancel inherited transitions inside committed modern subtrees
pure Feature regressions were unnecessarily coupled to Laravel Dusk
limitations: This is PHP 8.1 evidence only; it does not complete the other PHP versions in the frozen support matrix.
The package minimum is now explicitly PHP >=8.0 and Laravel 8-10.
A Composer dry-run with platform.php=8.0.0 resolves successfully to Laravel 8.83.29 and Dusk 6.25.2, but a real PHP 8.0 runtime regression remains outstanding.
The pinned Laravel 8 / PHP 8.0 / Dusk 6.25.2 supplemental regression remains outstanding.
Manual screen-reader reading-order and 200% zoom review remains outstanding.
The reviewed CI workflow still requires an authorized write to .github/workflows.
